rawContent: @wins_black @villagevoice Are you implying that protecting this known predator because he’s black is more important than protecting the black women that he victimized? #MeToo was started by a black Woman exactly because our victimization is downplayed even by our own people.
Thank you #MuteRKelly and #MeToo for being the voice of these girls and women. #SurivingRKelly
